registration.status: Ongoing insolvency proceedings; opened 2020-08-25. Administrator case-page status reviewed as of 2026-11-09; page has no update date.

adverse_media.status: Ongoing according to administrator case page; case 1542 IN 1308/20, opened 2020-08-25.
adverse_media.summary: Munich Local Court opened insolvency proceedings over Wirecard AG assets and appointed Michael Jaffé.

adverse_media.status: Judgment issued; no later appellate status verified.
adverse_media.summary: Munich Regional Court I declared Wirecard AG annual financial statements and profit-appropriation resolutions for financial years 2017 and 2018 null and void.

adverse_media.status: Not final when reported on 2024-09-05; subsequent appellate status not verified. Distinct from criminal proceedings.
adverse_media.summary: Former CEO Markus Braun and two other former executives were ordered to pay EUR 140 million in damages over loans to an Asian business partner, according to reporting dated 2024-09-05. The claim was brought by the insolvency administrator for the Wirecard estate.

adverse_media.status: Federal Court of Justice judgment IX ZR 127/24 issued 2025-11-13.
adverse_media.summary: Federal Court of Justice held that Wirecard AG shareholders capital-market damages claims are not ordinary insolvency claims and do not rank alongside ordinary creditors.

adverse_media.status: High-court decision; certain older claims were time-barred and requested non-destruction relief failed. Not a fraud conviction or fine against Wirecard AG.
adverse_media.summary: Federal Court of Justice largely upheld the insolvency administrator entitlement to information and access to auditor files concerning Wirecard AG; the proceedings also involved Wirecard Technologies GmbH.

adverse_media.status: Trial ongoing in reporting dated 2026-10-28; no verdict date fixed. No later outcome verified as of 2026-11-09.
adverse_media.summary: Latest opened report describes the Munich trial of former CEO Markus Braun and two co-defendants approaching closing stages. Prosecutors allege fictitious revenues were used to deceive lending banks; Braun denies the allegations. This concerns conduct at Wirecard AG, not a corporate criminal conviction.
adverse_media.category: Criminal fraud allegations concerning former management

pep_assessment.summary: No PEP status substantiated for the identified administrator or reported board members. Current beneficial owners and current board service remain unverified; an empty pep array is not a negative screen. Former executives Braun and Marsalek are not treated as current officers.

output.risk_rationale: High risk as of 2026-11-09: Wirecard AG is subject to ongoing insolvency administration following its 2020 collapse; its 2017 and 2018 annual accounts were declared void in 2022. Civil liability proceedings against former executives resulted in a reported damages award in 2024, and the criminal fraud trial concerning former management remained without a verdict in the latest opened October 2026 report; allegations are not convictions. The Federal Court of Justice issued material insolvency and auditor-file rulings in 2025. Current beneficial ownership, a current national-register extract and complete official sanctions-list screening remain unresolved. No sanctions or PEP clearance is asserted. These gaps and the established insolvency/accounting history require enhanced due diligence before any relationship.

registration_notes.summary: A company-specific current national-register extract and a direct GLEIF record could not be obtained. The court order verifies the legal name, register number and German court. The opened LEI record is hosted by the managing LEI issuer, not GLEIF itself.

LEI issuer record: entity status ACTIVE; LEI registration LAPSED; last update 2020-11-13. Its Einsteinring 35, 85609 Aschheim address is stale for current-address verification. A commercial register-derived page instead reports Humboldtstraße 8, 85609 Aschheim, with last register entry 2022-06-27. Current registered address is therefore left null pending a national-register extract.

The commercial register-derived page reports articles dated 1999-05-06; this is not verified incorporation from the national register and is not used as incorporation_date. It lists Steidl, Freis and von Knoop as management-board members, but does not establish current active service in 2026.
